title: Thank you for making this amazing app
body: This app has improved my life significantly since i started using it, and I wish everyone i know would use it. This is the only app worth paying money for.
author: faisalbendary

title: Just Beautiful
body: The design idea behind it is an inspiration, minimalistic yet so featured and nice looking, it’s enough to say that when i lost my apple account, i couldn’t live another day without rebuying the app
author: YoussefEbayya

title: Can’t live without it
body: Outstanding app for habit building. Great UX and UI design, and very thoughtful of its users too ( as evident by its user rating system ).
author: Zeinna77

title: Great
body: I have been loving this app in the past couple of months.
author: SheiryMagdy

title: Good idea, not greatly performed
body:
The idea behind the app is great, but there are many other apps that do the same thing, so you ought to be special,
Please add those features :-
1) ability to add any number of todos (habits), not just 6
2) graphical (chart or diagram) for my progress throughout time.
3) syncing with third party apps like evernote.
Thanks
author: Michael Ragaee
